# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No further fixes were applied in this stage. The fifth review approved the latest remediation as-is, so the codebase remained unchanged and this pass only records that the remaining notes were non-blocking follow-ups outside the required scope of this bead.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the approved validation output from completion round 5 to determine whether any actionable fixes remained after the latest remediation pass.
1. [Completed] Confirmed that the remaining review notes were non-blocking follow-ups only and did not require additional source, test, documentation, or backlog changes for this bead.
2. [Skipped] Apply further code or documentation fixes.
3. [Completed] Recorded the approved outcome and carried forward the existing validation record because no code changed in this pass.

## Validation Evidence

- `run-20260327155320-review-c1-a1-cr5` concluded with `outcome: approved`.
- No new code changes were made in this pass, so no additional validation commands were necessary.
- The current validation record remains the previously successful runs: `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo test -q -p tank_core --test concentration_helpers`, `cargo test -q -p tank_core --test plant_algae_integration`, `cargo test -q -p tank_core --test save_load`, `cargo test --quiet`, and `cargo clippy --all-targets --quiet`.

## Outstanding Risks

- Legacy process field names such as `plant_half_saturation_n_mg_total` and `aob_k_tan_mg` still read like total-mass parameters even though runtime semantics now normalize them onto concentration- or area-based units; that rename work remains deferred to downstream normalization beads.
- `TankState` convenience helpers still each recompute `self.concentrations()` when called individually in sequence, so non-hot-path callers can still pay repeated net-volume lookups unless they reuse `ConcentrationView` explicitly.
- Schema-2 save migration still assumes legacy dissolved totals were authored against gross water volume, so a hand-edited or previously pre-migrated schema-2 file could be rescaled again on load.
